# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read and follow `docs-host/AI_DEVELOPMENT.md` before proposing or changing code.

Also follow `AGENTS.md` for version-specific Laravel Boost guidance. Treat the protected super administrator and idempotent initialization behavior as non-negotiable business invariants. Never expose secrets from `.env`.

Use Laravel 13, Filament 5, Livewire 4, PHP 8.5, PHPUnit 12, and Tailwind CSS 4 APIs that match the installed lock files. Run the verification commands listed in `docs-host/AI_DEVELOPMENT.md` for the files you change.
